Comment: Tweak fog (fog effect), shake (earthquake effect), glitch (screen filter and audio wack at values above 0.5), waviness (terrain rounding), warping (terrain tremble), and various feature toggles.
BellsComment: Toggles the toll of a distant church bell for approaching warnings.
FunnyModeComment: When enabled, exaggerates glitch and shake effects.
TemporalStormMusicComment: Play music during temporal storms that changes based on enemy proximity.
DetectRadiusComment: Distance (in blocks) from enemies to trigger combat music transition.
IntenseEnemyThresholdComment: Amount of aggressive enemies required nearby to trigger the intense storm cue.
IntenseEnemyRangeComment: Distance (in blocks) checked for aggressive enemies before triggering the intense storm cue.
ThunderlordRoarAffectedByAudioDistortion: When enabled, Thunderlord roar is affected by temporal audio distortion.
ThunderlordFootstepShakeStrengthComment: Camera shake strength for Thunderlord footsteps. Set to 0 to mute footstep sound and disable footstep shake.
ThunderlordRoarShakeStrengthComment: Camera shake strength for Thunderlord roars. Set to 0 to disable roar shake.
TempQuakesAffectedByAudioDistortionComme: When enabled, temporal quake sounds are affected by temporal audio distortion.
TempIntenseAffectedByAudioDistortionComm: When enabled, tempintense effect sounds are affected by temporal audio distortion.
HotbarGearComment: Hides the temporal stability cog on the hotbar.
MachineGearRendererComment: Hides the Huge gears and Thunderlord with low temporal stability.
